resources.string: How to use TappyAI
What each part does, and what to expect.
Chatting with TappyAI

Ask a question in your own words and TappyAI answers. It decides on its own when it needs to look something up.

1. Open Chat and type what you want to know.
2. Write naturally — full sentences work better than keywords.
3. Add the details that matter to you, such as an area, a budget, or an occasion.
4. Read the answer, then ask a follow-up to narrow it down.

You can also tap the microphone and speak instead of typing.

If TappyAI cannot find something, it says so instead of guessing. It will not invent a shop, a price, or a link.
Finding food and drink

Ask for somewhere to eat or drink and TappyAI suggests real places with their details.

1. Say what you want — for example, "quiet coffee shop in District 1".
2. Mention the area, or allow location so nearby places can be found.
3. Open the suggestion you like.

Each place comes with its name and address, its Google rating when there is one, a Google Maps button, and food delivery buttons that search for that restaurant.

Not every place has a website, a rating, or a delivery listing. When one is missing the button is simply not shown — nothing made up is put in its place.
Planning a trip

Ask about a destination and TappyAI suggests places to go and where to stay.

1. Name the destination, and the dates if you know them.
2. Say what kind of trip it is — family, budget, a few days.
3. Open a suggestion to see the detail, or ask for something different.

For places to stay you get a hotel list with Booking.com and Agoda buttons that open a search for that place.

Prices and availability belong to the booking sites, not to TappyAI. Confirm the final price there before you pay.
Looking for a product

Describe a product and TappyAI helps you compare it and points you to where it is sold.

1. Describe what you want, including the model if you know it.
2. Say what matters most — budget, size, or how you will use it.
3. Open a shopping link to check the current price.

You get a comparison in plain language plus Shopee, Tiki and Lazada buttons that search for that product.

TappyAI cannot see live stock or checkout prices. Treat any price it mentions as a rough guide and confirm on the store page.
Listening to answers

TappyAI can read an answer out loud instead of you reading it.

1. Send a message and wait for the answer.
2. Tap the speaker button under the answer to start reading.
3. Tap it again to stop.

The answer is spoken using the voice built into your phone. How it sounds depends on which language voices your phone has installed. If your phone has no voice for that language, the answer stays on screen as text.
Notifications

TappyAI can notify you about things you asked it to keep an eye on.

1. Allow notifications when the app asks.
2. Open Notifications in your profile to see what has arrived.
3. Tap a notification to open what it refers to.

If you refuse the permission, nothing is sent to your phone. You can still open the in-app list at any time.
The Tappy notification sound

Some notifications come from Tappy itself and play their own recognisable sound, so you know it is Tappy without looking at the screen.

1. Open Settings from your profile.
2. Find the Tappy notification sound row.
3. Tap it to turn the sound on or off.

Turning it off only silences that sound. The notifications still arrive and still appear in your list.
Reviews from other people

A feed of short reviews people have posted about places.

1. Open Reviews to browse the feed.
2. Open a review to read it in full and see the place.
3. Post your own review from the same screen.

Newer or quieter places may have no reviews yet.
Saving things for later

Keep places and content you want to come back to.

1. Tap the save control on something you like.
2. Find it again under Saved in your profile.

Saving needs an account, so that the list follows you between devices.
The small tools

A few focused tools sit alongside chat for everyday jobs.

• Scan — photograph a document and get the text out of it.
• Translate — translate text between languages.
• Currency — convert an amount between currencies.
• Split bill — work out who owes what after a shared meal.

Each tool tells you when it cannot finish — for example when a photo is too blurry to read.
Your account

You can start using TappyAI without an account. Signing in is what lets your things follow you.

• Without an account — chat and browse.
• With an account — saved items, your reviews, notifications, and preferences.

When something needs an account, TappyAI asks you to sign in at that point rather than blocking you earlier.
What to keep in mind

• TappyAI can be wrong. Treat what it says as a starting point, not the final word.
• Opening hours, prices and availability change. Confirm on the place's own page before you travel or pay.
• A button only appears when the underlying source really provides that link. A missing button means the information does not exist, not that it was hidden.
• TappyAI does not give financial or investment advice.
